snippet.description:

EA SPORTS™ NHL® 27 brings every NHL team's identity to life on the ice, in the arena, and through the broadcast.

Experience Authentic Atmospheres across all 32 NHL arenas with real-world goal songs, new broadcast package and updated crowds.

A refreshed broadcast package featuring John Buccigross and Darren Pang delivers new commentary, modern graphics, updated visuals, and richer storytelling for a more authentic NHL presentation.

Connected Franchise lets you create and run your own online league with up to 32 human-controlled teams, complete with customizable rules, flexible scheduling, roster management, and powerful commissioner tools.

On the ice, 32 unique Team Playbooks powered by NHL EDGE data bring authentic team identities to life. From breakouts to special teams and late-game strategy, every matchup feels more distinct, making every shift matter.

snippet.title: KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS Official Trailer
snippet.description:
KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS in cinemas worldwide with limited screenings from August 12. 
tickets now on sale at http://katseyewildheartsfilm.com/

Two-time GRAMMY®-nominated global girl group KATSEYE is coming to cinemas worldwide with a special theatrical release ahead of their third EP, WILD.

KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS is a captivating journey into the group's bold new era while celebrating the fans who helped make it possible. Featuring never-before-seen footage, EYEKONS fan videos, and intimate interviews from the group members, the film explores the powerful bond between KATSEYE and their global fandom. A love letter to the EYEKONS who helped build this movement, KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS reveals why this group's story is only just beginning.

From the intense pressure of Dream Academy to chart-topping viral success, audiences experience the highs, setbacks, sacrifices, and breakthrough moments that transformed KATSEYE on their path to global pop stardom. Praised by outlets including The New York Times, Vogue, Rolling Stone, and Billboard, KATSEYE has earned acclaim for their relentless dedication to their craft and electrifying live performances. As one of pop's most exciting emerging global acts, the group continues to solidify its place as a worldwide force.

From the same team that created Netflix’s POP STAR ACADEMY, KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS is produced by Interscope Films and Boardwalk Pictures, in partnership with HYBE X GEFFEN, and directed by Nadia Hallgren.

snippet.title: Young Ghost & Tommy Exclusive First Look & Teaser Breakdown | Power Origins Season 1
snippet.description:
In this video we break down the first official teaser for Power Origins — the highly anticipated origin story of Ghost, Tommy, and Kanan as ambitious young entrepreneurs on the rise in the streets of New York City.

Created by 50 Cent and brought to life by Sascha Penn (the same mastermind behind Raising Kanan Season 5), Power Origins delivers a fun, rambunctious look at how legends are made. We get our first real look at young Ghost and Tommy in action — talking shit, dreaming big, and causing absolute mayhem as they prove they can do this on their own.

From the car scenes where Ghost lays out his vision to the wild baseball-bat energy with Tommy, we dissect every frame. We also dive into how Ghost and Tommy first cross paths with a more seasoned Kanan, the timeline connection to Raising Kanan Season 5, the role of Breeze, and why this younger, hungrier version of Ghost is going to be very different from the smooth operator we knew in the original Power series.

Sascha Penn has already proven he knows how to cast these roles perfectly with Raising Kanan Season 5, and the early signs are that Spencer Moore as young Ghost and Charlie Mann as Tommy are going to kill it. The brotherhood, the betrayals, the trials, and the unbridled audacity — it’s all here.
Comment your thoughts — I’ll be in the comments too!

snippet.title: FATAL FURY: CotW ｜ Season 3 Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
City of the Wolves is Destined for Revenge in Season 3.
New fighter and content update every month from July 23!
-------------------------------
Destined for Revenge in Season 3.
City of the Wolves continues its evolution with monthly updates. New characters, new stages, new fervor, new fury!
 
Destined for Revenge replaces the previous overarching theme (Season 2's Legends Unleashed) as even more fighters—and their vengeance-fueled fates—descend upon South Town's sinister streets. Monthly DLC updates will help shape the competitive landscape as City of the Wolves pushes new boundaries for its player base going forward.
Season 3 will add the following DLC characters to the playable roster, with mystery fighters slated for release in October and December. Further details will be revealed in due course.
 
Season 3 Character Lineup  
- Rick Strowd (July 23, 2026)
- Duck King (August 2026)
- Kim Kaphwan (September 2026)
- Mystery character (October 2026)
- Laocorn (November 2026)
- Mystery character (December 2026)

FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves Revenge Edition (includes Season Passes 1–3)
・Price: $49.99/€49.99
・Format: Digital
Contents
Base game
- Season Pass 1 (Andy Bogard / Ken / Joe Higashi / Chun-Li / Mr. Big)
- Season Pass 2 (Kim Jae Hoon / Nightmare Geese / Blue Mary / Wolfgang Krauser / Mr. Karate / Kenshiro)
- Season Pass 3 (Rick Strowd / Duck King / Kim Kaphwan / ??? / Laocorn / ???)

snippet.title: Battlefield 6 Season 4 Naval Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Naval warfare has arrived, bringing all-out combat across land, air, and sea. 

Deploy to Tsuru Reef, our biggest battlefield yet, where sprawling islands, dynamic waves, boats, jets, helicopters, and ground vehicles collide in massive battles. Command the coastline with the RCB-90 Patrol Boat or race through the surf in the 7.7m NSW RHIB. 

Expand your arsenal with four new weapons, including the long-range Interdictor sniper rifle, then climb the ranks in a brand-new Ranked Battle Royale season packed with fresh rewards. And later in the season, Wake Island returns. 

Prepare to deploy when Season 4 launches on July 21.

#Battlefield6

snippet.title: DIGGER | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Digg. Or Die. DIGGER. Only in theaters October 2. #Diggermovie



Academy Award winner Tom Cruise stars in Academy Award-winning filmmaker Alejandro G. Iñárritu’s original film “Digger,” from Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures.
The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity’s savior before the disaster he’s unleashed destroys everything.
Cruise stars in the title role, alongside Oscar winner Riz Ahmed, John Goodman, Oscar nominee Sandra Hüller, Michael Stuhlbarg, and Oscar nominee Jesse Plemons.  Robert John Burke, Emma D’Arcy, Burn Gorman and Sophie Wilde also star. 
Iñárritu directed from a screenplay by Iñárritu & Oscar-winners Alexander Dinelaris & Nicolás Giacobone, and Sabina Berman, story by Iñárritu & Berman.  The film is produced by Iñárritu, Oscar nominee Mary Parent, Cruise and Michael Sharp, and executive produced by Joshua Grode, Berman, Dinelaris, Giacobone, Jez Butterworth and Emmanuel Lubezki.
Joining Iñárritu behind the camera are previous collaborators Oscar-winning director of photography Emmanuel Lubezki; editors Conor O’Neill and Oscar winner Stephen Mirrone; Oscar-nominated costume designer Jacqueline West; Oscar-winning makeup and hair designer Alessandro Bertolazzi; and Oscar-nominated casting director Francine Maisler; along with Oscar-winning production designer Dennis Gassner and production designer Richard Johnson, Oscar-winning prosthetic makeup designer Kazu Hiro, and composer Cosmo Sheldrake.
An Alejandro G. Iñárritu Film, “Digger” was shot entirely in VistaVision and will be released in theaters and IMAX® across North America on October 2, 2026, and internationally beginning 30 September 2026.  It will be distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures.

snippet.title: MODERN WARFARE 4 MULTIPLAYER GAMEPLAY REVEAL LIVE: FULL MW4 MULTIPLAYER GAMEPLAY!
snippet.description:
NEW OFFICIAL MW4 MULTIPLAYER GAMEPLAY REVEAL LIVE: FANATICS FEST SHOWCASE!
►Excited for Modern Warfare 4?  Hit 👍 LIKE and ✅ Subscribe - Thank you!
►Please show some love to all the streamers we're watching from Fanatics Fest!

See fresh Modern Warfare 4 gameplay featuring new environments and detailed weapon inspections. Get a closer look at the M4 rifle. This footage provides an early look at the latest Modern Warfare 4 environments and combat mechanics. If you are a fan of FPS titles, this breakdown offers a clear view of how the game handles movement and weapon fidelity in current development builds. We focus specifically on the weapon arsenal, highlighting the updated M4 rifle model and how it interacts with different map layouts. By examining these Modern Warfare 4 clips, you can better understand the visual direction and mechanical focus of the upcoming release. Today we have ACTUAL MW4 Multiplayer Gameplay showcasing the new gunplay in MW4. Developed by Infinity Ward, Modern Warfare 4 marks a new chapter for the studio with the grounded, authentic, high-stakes military action Modern Warfare is known for. Players can expect the edge and intensity that define Modern Warfare, delivered with a renewed focus on authenticity and immersion across Campaign, Multiplayer, and DMZ. Set against a rapidly escalating global conflict centered on the Korean Peninsula, Modern Warfare 4 pushes the series into darker and more dangerous territory as a full-scale invasion of South Korea threatens to destabilize the world. Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer delivers grounded, precise combat where fluid movement, player choice, and greater control define every engagement. Ballistic Authority: For Modern Warfare 4, a new weapon-first technology stack unifies precision aiming, physical handling, realistic audio propagation, enhanced visibility, and smarter combat perception into the most authentic Modern Warfare gunplay yet. Bullet trajectory, weapon motion, Operator stance, camera, audio, FOV, and target visibility all line up in one highly tuned combat fidelity system. The promise is simple: no bloom, no guesswork, and no doubt. Every shot tells the truth. Precision tuned combat, where every system is finely tuned to create a seamless connection between player, weapon, and combat. Weapon bloom has been removed from hipfire, making shots feel more connected to where the weapon is pointed while delivering consistent, predictable, and fair gunplay. Movement is grounded and built for fluid transitions and greater control, giving players new ways to push forward, change angles, and adapt under pressure. On day one, players will deploy across 12 all-new core 6v6 maps set in visually and tactically distinct locations around the world, built to support a range of playstyles from tight close-quarters combat to more open engagements. Beyond the core 6v6 offering, Multiplayer also features dedicated Gunfight maps, multiple Big War maps built for vehicle and infantry combat, and Kill Block, a dynamic battleground with more than 500 configurations that reshape routes, sightlines, and cover to keep players adapting round after round. The all-new Gunny system brings a Gunnery Sergeant’s eye weapon customization, helping players quickly assemble effective builds based on their preferred playstyle and unlocked attachments. Expanded, streamlined customization puts more control in players’ hands, with a unified loadout system, robust Gunsmith, and more weapons, equipment, and killstreaks at launch. Apex Attachments unlock at max weapon progression, evolving each weapon with new behaviors that open up additional tactical playstyles. Modern Warfare 4 introduces greater player choice through two Prestige paths: Classic Prestige and Regular Prestige. Classic Prestige delivers the traditional reset experience, relocking Create-a-Class progression in exchange for increased XP earn rates and access to exclusive Prestige rewards. Let me know are you excited for Modern Warfare 4  Campaign, or more excited for Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 DMZ? Or COD MW4 Multiplayer? Call of Duty 2026 is Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 from Infinity Ward, published by Activision. Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 Trailer.

snippet.description:
This is Minecraft But we're Upgrading HOUSE HEAD Into a GOD In Minecraft! When Steve's body gets transformed into HOUSEHEAD like the Bunker Head, Bank Head, Gym Head, and more, he needs to UPGRADE himself by entering the mysterious portals! Steve needs to learn how to evolve himself to absurd levels so he can use the HOUSE HEAD overpowered upgrade abilities! MORE CHECKPOINT ADVENTURES:

‣ MINECRAFT DIMENSION: https://bit.ly/3mKfUOL

Minecraft is an open world game that has no specific goals for the player to accomplish, allowing players a large amount of freedom in choosing how to play the game however, there is an achievement system. The gameplay by default is first person, but players have the option to play in third person mode. The core gameplay revolves around breaking and placing blocks. The game world is essentially composed of rough 3D objects—mainly cubes—that are arranged in a fixed grid pattern and represent different materials, such as dirt, stone, various ores, water, and tree trunks. While players can move freely across the world, objects and items can only be placed at fixed locations relative to the grid. Players can gather these material blocks and place them elsewhere, thus allowing for various constructions.

Minecraft is an open world game that has no specific goals for the player to accomplish, allowing players a large amount of freedom in choosing how to play the game however, there is an achievement system. The gameplay by default is first person, but players have the option to play in third person mode. The core gameplay revolves around breaking and placing blocks. The game world is essentially composed of rough 3D objects—mainly cubes—that are arranged in a fixed grid pattern and represent different materials, such as dirt, stone, various ores, water, and tree trunks. While players can move freely across the world, objects and items can only be placed at fixed locations relative to the grid. Players can gather these material blocks and place them elsewhere, thus allowing for various constructions.
